dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Vaaaarka! Time to get back to woooork~

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...What, haven't you heard the saying, "don't wake someone pretending to be asleep"?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Fine, it's the hunter who decides what to do with their prey... But next time, I'm napping somewhere harder to find!

choices.text: Isn't it, "You can't wake someone pretending to be asleep"?
